% Pattern: env/conditional/article. An etoolbox toggle hides a theorem, and a
% test with no third argument before a blank line.
% from 2312.00752
% want theorem-1 statement/theorem 1
% want remark-1 remark 2
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{etoolbox}
\newtoggle{arxiv}
\toggletrue{arxiv}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}
\newtheorem{remark}[theorem]{Remark}
\begin{document}
\iftoggle{arxiv}{}{
\begin{theorem}
Only in the conference version.
\end{theorem}
}
\begin{theorem}
In each version.
\end{theorem}
\iftoggle{arxiv}{
Some text for arXiv only.
}

\begin{remark}
After the blank line.
\end{remark}
\end{document}
